subject.title: fix(pairing): preserve authorized senders when allowFrom reads fail

question: Should this PR be repaired into a narrow pairing-only fail-closed fix before merge, or should maintainers intentionally sponsor the broad current-head bundle?
rationale: The current branch has a useful core bug fix but also a concrete auth-state defect and broad unrelated security-sensitive surfaces, and the maintainer label means automation should not choose the product/merge boundary alone.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Drop the unrelated current-head drift, make mutation pre-reads throw on malformed JSON parse failures, and rerun focused pairing proof before landing.

options.title: Accept as maintainer bundle
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally own the broad workflow, dependency, app, docs, plugin, and UI changes after reviewing those surfaces as part of this PR.

options.title: Pause for a fresh narrow PR
options.body: Close or supersede this branch only after preserving the useful pairing work and credit in a clean replacement PR.

recommendation.title: Repair before merge
recommendation.body: Drop the unrelated current-head drift, make mutation pre-reads throw on malformed JSON parse failures, and rerun focused pairing proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current PR branch, assignment, and the follow-up commits that introduced the remaining normalization behavior.
